title: Localized isolating test form at a point of a lattice face
statement: Let n, N ∈ ℕ, ρ > 0, F₀ = (z, α) ∈ LatticeFaceIndex n N, x ∈ latticeFace ρ F₀, and W ⊆ ℝ^N open with x ∈ W. Then there is a test form ω ∈ TestFormOn univ n (a C^∞ compactly supported n-form on ℝ^N) with three properties. (1) tsupport ω ⊆ W. (2) latticeFaceAction ρ F ω = 0 for every face index F ≠ F₀. (3) latticeFaceAction ρ F₀ ω > 0. Here latticeFaceAction ρ F ω = ∫_{latticeFace ρ F} ω(y)(e_{F.2(0)}, …, e_{F.2(n−1)}) dH^n(y), with e_a = EuclideanSpace.single a 1 and H^n = μHE[n].
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) (F₀ : LatticeFaceIndex n N) (x : Eucl N) (W : Set (Eucl N)), 0 < ρ → x ∈ latticeFace ρ F₀ → IsOpen W → x ∈ W → ∃ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) n, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl N) n) ⊆ W ∧ (∀ F : LatticeFaceIndex n N, F ≠ F₀ → latticeFaceAction ρ F (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl N) n) = 0) ∧ 0 < latticeFaceAction ρ F₀ (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl N) n)
